label: 1987 Amendment — Definitions + Employer Liability Limitation
added_provisions: Cal. Civil Code §3294(b) — employer liability limitation (advance knowledge, authorization/ratification, or personally guilty)
Cal. Civil Code §3294(c) — definitions of malice, oppression, and fraud
§3294(c)(1) — malice: intent to cause injury OR despicable + conscious disregard
§3294(c)(2) — oppression: despicable + cruel hardship + conscious disregard
§3294(c)(3) — fraud: intentional misrepresentation + material fact + intent to deprive or injure
retained_provisions: Cal. Civil Code §3294(a) — clear and convincing evidence standard (retained from 1872 codification)
significance: Current operative version of §3294; §3294(c) definitions control all California punitive damages analysis
